description: This file contains the implementation of the Currency model class in the OpenCart admin system, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve currency data from the database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class for handling currency data operations in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Adds a new currency record to the database and clears the currency cache.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record in the database by currency ID and clears the cache.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the currency value in the database based on the currency code and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Deletes a currency record from the database by ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Fetches a currency record from the database by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Returns a list of currencies with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total count of currency records in the database.
